environment.description: Same NestJS catalog microservice in namespace 'catalog-frontend'. Istio service mesh with STRICT mTLS PeerAuthentication. An AuthorizationPolicy resource 'deny-cross-ns-cache-admin' is applied with spec.action DENY matching source.notNamespaces ['catalog-backend'] on paths ['/internal/*']. A second AuthorizationPolicy 'restrict-forwarded-headers' uses a custom Envoy filter (envoy.filters.http.header_to_metadata) that strips X-Forwarded-Host from any request originating outside the mesh (missing valid SPIFFE identity). The Istio sidecar's outbound traffic policy is REGISTRY_ONLY, preventing the cache poisoning vector where an attacker-controlled X-Forwarded-Host value gets cached and served to subsequent users, because the ingress gateway's EnvoyFilter normalizes X-Forwarded-Host to the VirtualService's registered host before forwarding to the sidecar.

typed_config.inline_code: function envoy_on_request(handle) local xff = handle:headers():get('x-forwarded-host'); if xff then handle:headers():replace('x-forwarded-host', 'catalog.prod.internal') end end
